name: Alorica (Partner) (2nd Position)
desc:
Accounting/Bookkeeping Support (Work at Home) | $17 to $21/hr | Phone Support, Upselling Expected
Company: Alorica
Industry: Financial Services / Call Center
What Your Day Will Look Like: You'd talk with customers who have questions or problems with a financial product or service, listen for what's really behind the question, and walk them through a clear answer. You'd write down the details of each call so the account is accurate and the next person can pick up where you left off. Part of the job is spotting when a customer could use a new or better service and recommending it in a helpful way. The posting says the work supports financial support programs, and it asks for accounting, bookkeeping, or payroll experience, so expect some money-related account questions. The posting doesn't name the client, so ask about that early.
assessment: Yes, Completing assessment is required to submit application
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: High school diploma or GED.
Required Experience: 6 months to 1 year of customer service experience plus accounting, bookkeeping, and/or payroll experience. The posting also lists sales experience, or being okay with upselling, in the same line. The wording is a little unclear, so confirm with the recruiter what counts.
Preferred Experience: QuickBooks experience. QuickBooks certification is a plus.
Required Skills:
Active listening and clear, simple explanations
Staying calm under pressure
Attention to detail and accurate record keeping
Comfort suggesting new services to customers
Comfort using company-issued equipment, including a webcam if needed
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone with bookkeeping, payroll, or accounting experience who also has customer service experience
Someone with QuickBooks experience, or a QuickBooks certification
Someone who wants a remote role that uses their money skills while talking with people
Someone comfortable making helpful recommendations to customers
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone with no accounting, bookkeeping, or payroll background, since it's listed as required
Anyone who doesn't want any upselling in their job
Anyone who can't meet the internet rules (satellite, dial-up, and 5G or wireless connections are not accepted)
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process: 1. Application 2. Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you. 3. If assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen. 4. If phone screen passes you can expect the final interview. Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3-15 days on average.

Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Customer service
Bookkeeping and accounting support
Payroll processing
QuickBooks
Account record maintenance
Call documentation and reporting
Upselling and service recommendations
Active listening
Data accuracy
Financial support


4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your accounting, bookkeeping, or payroll experience and what software you've used.
How do you explain a money question in plain language to someone who is confused?
How do you feel about recommending new services to a customer?
Walk us through how you keep records accurate while you're on a call.
How do you stay calm and helpful with a customer who is worried about money?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay:$17 to $21/hr.
Shift: Full-time and regular. Hours are not stated in the posting, confirm directly.
Benefits: Health, dental, and vision coverage with HSA options, paid time off, 401(k), and flexible pay options with daily or weekly pay. Paid training and tuition reimbursement, leadership development programs, and open access courses through Alorica Academy. Employee discounts on groceries, travel, insurance, phone plans, health and wellness, pet supplies, and more. Employee Assistance Program and additional voluntary benefits.
Equipment Provided: Company-issued equipment is mentioned, such as a webcam if applicable. Participant supplies the internet. It must be DSL or cable, with at least 10 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload and proof from the internet provider. The work-from-home space must be in a private residence that matches the address on file.
Felony Friendly?: Not stated.
Drug Test: Not stated.
Notes: Oklahoma is on the approved hiring state list (AL, AZ, AR, FL, GA, ID, IA, KS, LA, MS, MO, NE, NC, SC, OK, TN, TX, UT, WV, VA). This is one of the few remote leads in your database that asks for bookkeeping or payroll experience, so it's a good one for a participant with that background. The internal candidate rules in the posting (no corrective action, 6+ months in current position) don't apply to outside applicants. Daily or weekly pay is worth pointing out to participants. This is a separate opening from your other Alorica entries.
Career Pathway: Not stated directly in posting, though Alorica says most promotions come from within. Reasonable inferred path: Accounting/Bookkeeping Support → Senior Support Specialist → Team Lead → Customer Service Supervisor, though this is an estimate, not confirmed by Alorica directly.
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
